events.emailSubject: Jenny Dodson posted in MS Wildcat  Volleyball
events.emailBody:
https://www.sportsyou.com/

Jenny has posted in MS Wildcat  Volleyball 



Jenny Dodson


Schedule Correction for Tuesday, Sept. 15 ❤️🖤

A quick update to tomorrow’s volleyball schedule:

* B-Team is NOT scheduled to play
* Varsity will now play at 5:00 PM
* The home opponent is Beren Academy Stars, not Berean Christian

The corrected schedule has now been updated. I’m sorry for any confusion, especially for our B-Team families. I was working from the weekly schedule that had been shared, and that schedule has since been corrected as well.

Updated Match Schedule

AWAY vs. Cornerstone Cougars
C-Team — 4:30 PM
A-Team — 5:30 PM
Bus departs WLA at 3:30 PM

HOME vs. Beren Academy Stars
Varsity — 5:00 PM

Thank you for your understanding, and please use the updated graphic/schedule going forward. 🏐🐾
